title: Concurrent cache race condition
description: Defective starter; make the behavior in task.md true without changing the tests. python3 stdlib; threads.

starter.provenance: Authored for SDKit F05-A (2026-10). No third-party code. The defects are deliberate: see task.md for the required behavior.

requirements.text: Single flight: concurrent `get(key)` calls for a key that is not cached run the loader exactly once; every caller receives that value.
No global serialization: loads of different keys run concurrently. A slow load of one key must never block a load of another key.
Errors: if the loader raises, every caller waiting on that load receives that same exception. Nothing is cached; the next `get` calls the loader again.
TTL: an entry is valid while `clock() < stored_at + ttl` (expired exactly at the boundary), using the injected `clock`. An expired entry is reloaded (again single flight).
`invalidate(key)` removes a cached entry. If a load of that key is in flight, its callers still receive the value, but the value is not stored,
The cache never returns a value after a failed load of a different key, and a failure of one key does not affect other keys.
